Shaoxun Liu

Scientist · Cartography Biosciences

Bio

I'm a Scientist at Cartography Biosciences, where I build computational tools and develop algorithms for antibody engineering and target discovery.

I earned my Ph.D. at Columbia University in October 2026, co-mentored by Harmen Bussemaker and Richard Mann. My doctoral research combined biophysical modeling and machine learning to understand how transcription factors recognize DNA and how mutations alter their binding specificity.

My broader interests include machine learning, molecular dynamics, molecular biology, and structural biology.
